ABOUT THE ARCHIVE

A closer look at the game.

The original collection contains five decoded cache tables: 701 hero records, 2,670 battle actions, 10,157 monsters, 4,073 NPCs, and 170,387 English text entries. Variants count as separate records.

Search checks every field, including nested data. Numeric filters compare stored values. Open a record to inspect every field and nested list, or switch to its original JSON.

Newly recovered findings

125 additional JSON tables are now available in this explorer. The research area includes 6,344 recovered Lua scripts, XP calculations, compiled-code indexes, map references, story events, and the complete file audit.

Source: decoded caches from the supplied com.kakaogames.gdtskr folder. The cache date and client version are not verified. The separately inspected APK uses a different package name and supplied code evidence for the research area. Region and version alignment remain unverified.
